quests.title: Syntactic Block Architecture
quests.completeSentence: The curious astronomer observed distant galaxies through the observatory lens.
quests.coreRule: Subject precedes transitive verb, followed by direct object and prepositional phrase of instrument.

contrastExample.incorrect: Through the lens observed astronomer galaxies.
contrastExample.whyBroken: Misplacing the subject after the verb without inversion triggers syntactic confusion.

quests.cadenceExplanation: English is an SVO (Subject-Verb-Object) language. By anchoring the agent first, listeners track who is responsible before processing the action and its recipient.
